anomaly_label: Jumpy heater (H702, H706, H704, H708) power

evidence.observation: System pressure collapsed from ~649 mbar to 392-401 mbar at k=19-20
Differential pressure jumped from ~2 to ~6.9 mbar
Reflux flow dropped to ~0.005 L/h while FT704 distillate surged to 1.3-1.5 L/h
Column and condenser temperatures fell abruptly, breaking the steady heat-up profile

args.missing_evidence: Vacuum/pressure controller setpoint log and valve states to distinguish an intentional pressure change from an air in-leak; leak check of column seals and condenser.
